```{r config, include=FALSE}
# Repository location, separate from DATA_ROOT. Replace with the absolute path
# to your clone (the directory containing shared-R).
REPO_ROOT <- "/path/to/repo"
REPO_ROOT <- normalizePath(REPO_ROOT, mustWork = TRUE)
# Input locations. Set these before knitting.
DATA_ROOT <- "" # project data directory (per-analysis subdirectories)
```

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
set.seed(0)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = file.path(DATA_ROOT, "Alignment_Benchmarking/Mapping_Accuracy_Analysis/"))

library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
library(scales)
library("dplyr")
library(factoextra)
library(tidyr)
source(file.path(REPO_ROOT, "shared-R", "JFMV_2025_Aesthetic.R"))
library(ggrepel)
library(ggbeeswarm)
library(data.table)
```

```{r load data}
# Load data
data_pan <- fread("Combined_saturation_metrics_founder_Graph.txt")
data_mm10 <- fread("Combined_saturation_metrics.txt")
data_mT2T <- fread("Combined_saturation_metrics_mT2T_BWA.txt")

# filter for 2% subsample
subset(data_pan, subsample_percent==2) -> data_pan
subset(data_mm10, subsample_percent==2) -> data_mm10

# add group labels
data_pan$group <- "Pangenome"
data_mm10$group <- "GRCm38"
data_mT2T$group <- "mT2T"

# combine data
rbind(data_pan, data_mm10, data_mT2T) -> data_combined

# extract relevant columns
data_combined[,c(2,6:12)] -> data_combined

# save table
fwrite(
    data_combined,
    "Combined_saturation_metrics_2percent.txt",
    sep = "\t",
    quote = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
setDT(data_combined)

mapq_levels <- c("0", "1-9", "10-29", "30-59", "60")

mapq_summary <- data_combined[
    !is.na(mapq_bin),
    .(
        total_reads = sum(total, na.rm = TRUE),
        lifted_reads = sum(lifted, na.rm = TRUE),
        accurate_reads = sum(accurate, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    by = .(group, rg, mapq_bin)
]

mapq_summary[
    ,
    `:=`(
        lifted_within_bin_pct = 100 * lifted_reads / total_reads,
        accurate_within_bin_pct = 100 * accurate_reads / total_reads,
        accurate_given_lifted_within_bin_pct = fifelse(
            lifted_reads > 0,
            100 * accurate_reads / lifted_reads,
            NA_real_
        )
    )
]

mapq_summary[
    ,
    mapq_bin := factor(mapq_bin, levels = mapq_levels, ordered = TRUE)
]

mapq_summary[
    ,
    group := factor(group, levels = c("GRCm38", "mT2T", "Pangenome"), ordered = TRUE)
]
```

```{r}
mapq_summary[
  ,
  .(median_accuracy = median(accurate_given_lifted_within_bin_pct, na.rm = TRUE)),
  by = .(group, mapq_bin)
]
```

```{r}
ggplot(
    mapq_summary,
    aes(
        x = mapq_bin,
        y = accurate_given_lifted_within_bin_pct,
        group = rg
    )
) +
    geom_line(alpha = 0.30, linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.50, size = 1) +
    facet_wrap(~ group, nrow = 1) +
    scale_y_continuous(
        labels = percent_format(scale = 1),
        limits = c(0, 100)
    ) +
    labs(
        x = "MAPQ bin",
        y = "Accurate among lifted (%)",
        title = "Mapping accuracy by MAPQ bin"
    ) +
    theme_cowplot() +
    JFMVTheme
```

```{r plot boxplot, fig.width=4, fig.height=4}
mapq_medians <- mapq_summary[
    ,
    .(
        median_accuracy = median(accurate_given_lifted_within_bin_pct, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    by = .(group, mapq_bin)
]

ggplot(
    mapq_summary,
    aes(
        x = mapq_bin,
        y = accurate_given_lifted_within_bin_pct,
        fill = group
    )
  ) +
    geom_line(
        data = mapq_medians,
        aes(
            x = mapq_bin,
            y = median_accuracy,
            group = group,
            color = group
        ),
        position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
        linewidth = 1,
        alpha = 0.8
    ) +
    geom_boxplot(
        outlier.shape = NA,
        width = 0.7,
        position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)
    ) +
    geom_quasirandom(
        aes(color = group),
        dodge.width = 0.8,
        width = 0.15,
        alpha = 1,
        size = 0.75,
        stroke = 0
    ) +
    geom_point(
        data = mapq_medians,
        aes(
            x = mapq_bin,
            y = median_accuracy,
            group = group,
            color = group
        ),
        position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
        size = 1
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
        labels = percent_format(scale = 1),
        limits = c(0, 100)
    ) +
    labs(
        x = "MAPQ bin",
        y = "Accurate among lifted (%)",
        title = "Mapping accuracy by MAPQ bin"
    ) +
    theme_cowplot() +
    JFMVTheme +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("GRCm38" = "#4a7c8a", "mT2T" = "#c44e52", "Pangenome" = "#6a5acd")) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("GRCm38" = "#4a7c8a", "mT2T" = "#c44e52", "Pangenome" = "#6a5acd")) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom") -> Mapping_Accuracy_Boxplot

Mapping_Accuracy_Boxplot

# save as svg
ggsave(
    "Mapping_Accuracy_Boxplot.svg",
    plot = Mapping_Accuracy_Boxplot,
    width = 4,
    height = 4,
    units = "in"
)
```
